title: Unix OS lifecycle, default Unix VFS, and memdb VFS registration

scope.rationale: These functions are the active OS layer called by sqlite3_initialize: wrapper dispatch, the four-variant Linux Unix VFS table, shutdown, and memdb registration. Production owns concrete Unix locking-mode and memory adapters in one shared ABI registry.
excluded_responsibilities: Unix method bodies outside variant selection; posix/no-lock/dotfile/exclusive locking and method-tail selection have native evidence
VFS registry public find/register/unregister source entities
Memdb file implementation details beyond process VFS registration

external_source_responsibilities: Memdb file methods plus serialize/deserialize semantics are separate source units
dependencies.caller_closure: Top-level OS, the active Linux unix/unix-none/unix-dotfile/unix-excl table, memdb registration, and shutdown calls are assigned. Process-static owners preserve source names, order, default selection, and locking-method tails.

inputs: Initialized mutex/memory/PCache layers and process VFS registry
outputs: SQLITE_OK with unix default, unix-none, unix-dotfile, unix-excl, and named memdb VFS adapters registered
contracts.ownership: Four UnixVfs locking-mode owners, one MemoryVfs owner, and ABI adapters have process lifetime. Registry borrows adapter pointers and preserves them across shutdown/reinitialize.
contracts.state_and_results: OS initialization is idempotent under global serialization. unix is default; unix-none, unix-dotfile, unix-excl, and memdb are named non-default adapters. Shutdown clears OS initialized state but static VFS identities remain registered.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Registration mutates process registry during serialized initialization. No file I/O occurs during lifecycle itself.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: The target-profile static adapters and registry operations are infallible after earlier layer initialization. Shutdown/reinitialize preserves exact identities, table order, and default selection.

representation_differences: The active Linux source table and Zig both register unix, unix-none, unix-dotfile, and unix-excl in order with unix default; typed LockingMode replaces C finder pointers.
MemdbAdapter is VFS version 2, borrows the default Unix adapter for delegated services, selects max file size, and registers non-default. Memdb file/serialize semantics are separate units.
Source sqlite3_os_end validates profile globals; Zig clears lifecycle state while retaining process-static registry identities.

oracle.protocol: Process Coordinator tests verify exact Linux variant names, default, memdb lookup, and stable registration across shutdown. Unix tests verify posix v3, no-lock v3 without xShmMap, dotfile v1 directory contention, exclusive process-lifetime locking, URI/mmap/syscall overrides, OFD cross-process contention, process-death unlock, and rollback/WAL durability.
internal_observations: four-entry active Unix variant table and order
dotfile directory contention and v1 method tail
oracle.normalization: Static C/Zig adapter addresses are allocation identities; Linux variant cardinality, names, order, default, method versions/tails, lock outcomes, results, and lifecycle are exact.

assurance.oom: Lifecycle registration uses process-static owners and is allocation-free. Per-open Unix/memdb ownership failures have native cleanup coverage.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Lifecycle performs no I/O. Posix has OFD cross-process and process-death evidence; no-lock, dotfile, and exclusive modes have method-tail and contention tests. Memdb source concurrency remains open.
assurance.continuation: Repeated shutdown/reinitialize preserves the four Unix and memdb identities, order, and default.
assurance.performance: Four static adapters match the active Linux table. No-lock bypasses kernel locks, dotfile uses one lock directory, and exclusive retains one whole-file OFD lock until close.

integration.production_owner: src/core/global.zig process Unix/mem VFS owners and src/core/vfs.zig process registry
integration.native_call_path: process_coordinator invokes initializeProcessOs after PCache and shutdownProcessOs before PCache shutdown; public VFS APIs share vfs.process_vfs_head.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The duplicate private public_api VFS head was removed; lifecycle and public registration now share one process registry.

independent_review.notes: Scoped OS/registration behavior is integrated; requires registry event differential and independent review. Memdb file and serialize/deserialize methods are separate units.

known_blockers: Exact C/Zig registry event differential and independent review remain open.
Memdb file methods are trace-equivalent and serialize/deserialize have a separate scaffolded atomic unit; their remaining blockers are tracked there.
